about.title: About the Sword & Shield set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Sword & Shield is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 7 February 2020. It has 216 cards: 202 in the main set and 14 secret rares. There are also 165 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 202 main set cards), the Master set (367 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 381 cards, adding the 14 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
